statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-58039 is a Node.js Permission Model bypass: with --permission, the fs.write check for a diagnostic report was made against the report file name rather than the final path the report is written to, so when a report directory is set (--report-directory or process.report.directory) process.report could write and overwrite files outside the --allow-fs-write paths. Node.js fixed it for 24.x in 24.18.1, released 2026-07-29: the July 2026 security release, https://nodejs.org/en/blog/vulnerability/july-2026-security-releases, lists 24.x among the affected release lines, and the 24.18.1 release notes, https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v24.18.1, list this CVE. The fix is commit https://github.com/nodejs/node/commit/9a6b7e343a ('permission: check final report output path'), which carries CVE-ID: CVE-2026-58039 and is in the v24.18.1 tag and not in v24.18.0; outside tests it changes lib/internal/process/report.js and src/node_report.cc. The CVE record, https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-58039, lists Node.js 24 releases up to 24.18.0 as affected. The DHI nodejs-24 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from the upstream Node.js release tarball for their version. Each published nodejs-24 package holds one file, /usr/bin/node, a dynamically linked musl program that carries the Node.js JavaScript library and the C++ runtime where this code lives; the nodejs-24-dev subpackages hold C and C++ header files and two .gypi build configuration files under /usr/include/node, and the nodejs-24-doc subpackages hold the node man page and two debugger helper files, gdbinit and lldb_commands.py, with no ELF, PE or Mach-O file in either. We checked the node binary, /usr/bin/node, in every nodejs-24 package for Alpine 3.23 published by 2026-11-27, on x86_64 and aarch64 (checksums verified against the package index): 24.18.1-r0, 24.19.0-r0, 24.20.0-r0, 24.21.0-r0, 24.22.0-r0, 24.22.1-r0, 24.22.1-r1, 24.22.2-r0 and 24.22.3-r0 report v24.18.1 through v24.22.3 and carry the fix, while the earlier builds 24.13.0-r0, 24.13.1-r0, 24.14.0-r0, 24.14.1-r0, 24.15.0-r0, 24.15.0-r1, 24.16.0-r0, 24.17.0-r0 and 24.18.0-r0 report v24.13.0 through v24.18.0 and are affected. As a check, the source of lib/internal/process/report.js embedded in the node binary contains the check this fix adds to writeReport(), which prefixes the file name with the report directory, when one is set (nr.getDirectory()), before testing the fs.write permission, in 24.18.1-r0 and every later build on both architectures, and does not in any earlier build; the C++ report writer, node::TriggerNodeReport, which this fix changes to test the permission on the full output path, also changes size at 24.18.1-r0 on both architectures. 24.18.1-r0 is the first published build that carries the fix.
